//: Merge into <project>/.claude/settings.json. Comments are not valid JSON — strip the // keys before use.
//plansDirectory: Where built-in plan mode writes its plan files. Relative to the project root; must stay inside it. Without this, plans land in ~/.claude/plans/ and are not version-controlled. Set it: in plan mode the harness owns the plan path outright, so this is what keeps that file inside the repository too. Note /make-plan refuses to run while plan mode is active — the two are alternatives, not layers.
//env: CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_BACKGROUND_TASKS=1 keeps every subagent delegation in the foreground, so its report comes back inside the same turn and the invoking skill's model:/effort: pin survives. Since Claude Code 2.1.232 an interactive session backgrounds every subagent and nothing in an agent file can ask for the foreground; this is the documented switch, and it is measured: on 2.1.322 an /execute-plan run of 12 delegations logged zero task-notifications and held its effort and model throughout. It also disables run_in_background on Bash and Ctrl+B in this project. Do NOT set CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_MODEL_FORCE (every agent's model: pin is ignored, the tiering collapses onto one model) or CLAUDE_CODE_EFFORT_LEVEL (overrides /effort, settings and frontmatter effort alike).
//modelSettings: Optional. The safety net for the orchestrator tier if the skill pin drops: a skill's model:/effort: frontmatter applies for the current turn only, so /execute-plan falls back to the SESSION effort the moment a delegation returns as a background completion notification. This pins that fallback to medium for Sonnet sessions. It is per-model, so an Opus planning session is untouched. It does not reach agent frontmatter: implementer still overrides to effort: high in its own file regardless. THE KEY IS A CANONICAL MODEL NAME, not an alias: it must be the model `sonnet` resolves to today (the name /effort itself writes into this object, and the one an /execute-plan transcript records). When a release moves the alias, this entry silently stops applying — re-check it then.
//subagentStatusLine: Optional. Rewrites each worker's row under the prompt to show what the worker is doing: its current action, how many files it has changed, and its last test or check. Without it a row is name, description and a token count. install.sh places the script; it is standard-library Python and reads the worker's own transcript. Measured on Claude Code 2.1.322.
//permissions: Optional. Pre-allowing the read-only commands the orchestrator runs constantly cuts prompt fatigue during a long plan run.
